name: pixel-pets
description: Claude Pets: a pixel pet game and retro dashboard for Claude Code (terminal, desktop app and VS Code), with plan usage, weather, your backlog story, themes you colour yourself, pet voices and guardrails

backlogFiles.title: Backlog files
backlogFiles.description: Comma-separated markdown files a story id is looked up in (first hit wins), relative to the session's directory or absolute

storyIdPattern.title: Story id pattern
storyIdPattern.description: A regular expression with one capture group matching a backlog id (default matches E12-S03 and M1-14)

defectCommand.title: Defect command
defectCommand.description: What /defect starts its draft with: a slash command such as /report-defect, or leave empty for a plain request

petKind.title: Starting pet
petKind.description: The pet you start with; /pet <animal> switches later

petName.title: Starting pet name
petName.description: Up to 16 characters; /pet name renames it later

bandRows.title: Band rows
bandRows.description: Which rows the band shows, in order: banner, git, usage, weather, story, tests. Leave out any you don’t want.
bandRows.default: banner, git, usage, weather, story, tests

weatherPlace.title: Weather place
weatherPlace.description: A city to show the weather for (looked up once); empty means no weather and no requests. /weather sets it too

temperatureUnit.title: Temperature unit
temperatureUnit.description: °C, °F or both (wind follows: km/h or mph)

playerName.title: Player name
playerName.description: Your name on /pet board; empty means git's user.name, else your OS user

leaderboardUrl.title: Shared leaderboard URL
leaderboardUrl.description: The world board service (see server/README.md). Joining is still opt-in: nothing is sent until /pet join. Empty this to turn the world board off

githubClientId.title: Leaderboard GitHub app
githubClientId.description: The leaderboard's GitHub OAuth app Client ID (public by design; used for /pet join's device sign-in)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: A preset (ice, phosphor, amber, c64, mint, rose, mono, paper) or your own colours: #FF8800, or #FF8800 on #101010. /retro theme changes it later

font.title: Banner font
font.description: How the banner's letters look. The terminal's own font is set in your terminal app; this styles the banner within it
